title: Spicy Rice
description: A spiced side dish of long-grain rice cooked with peppers, onion and warming spices, finished with peas.

ingredients.text: ½ red onion, peeled and finely chopped
½ red pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
½ green pepper, deseeded and finely chopped
1 litre hot chicken (or vegetable) stock (1 cube dissolved in 1 litre boiling water)

steps: Spray a large frying pan with low-calorie cooking spray.
Add the chopped onion, peppers, cumin, chilli powder, turmeric and paprika.
Cook until the onions start to brown slightly.
Add the rice to the onions and peppers and stir to mix well.
Pour in the hot stock, then add the chicken (or veg) stock pot and stir.
Bring to the boil then cover with a lid and cook according to the packet  instructions.
Stir during cooking to prevent the rice sticking to the pan. Around 4 or 5 minutes before the end of cooking, stir in the peas and replace the lid.
When all the water has been absorbed and the rice is cooked, stir and serve with an accompaniment of your choice. (You can also put it in the freezer to have another day.)
